title: Custom Function with many parameters
description:
Code-style rule — custom functions with five or more parameters. Long signatures are hard to call correctly.

Based on the PMD rule ExcessiveParameterList — https://docs.pmd-code.org/latest/pmd_rules_java_design.html#excessiveparameterlist
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Many positional parameters are easy to mix up and hint at a missing structure.
rule.remediation: Pass a single JSON / dictionary parameter, or split the function.
